prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1361; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you state the location where the collision happened?

A: It was in the parking lot of a grocery store in Conroe, Texas, near the main entrance.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I had just pulled into a parking space and was backing out to leave. I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything behind me.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle at any point?

A: Not until right before impact. A pickup was coming down the aisle, and I think it was moving fairly quickly for a parking lot.

Q: How fast would you estimate you were going when you backed up?

A: Very slowly, maybe a walking pace. I was almost stopped.

Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?

A: The rear driver's side. The other truck hit my rear quarter panel.

Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: What injuries did you sustain?

A: I fractured my wrist. I put my hand out on the steering wheel and the force jarred it badly. I've been wearing a splint and I'm seeing a specialist next week.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene or afterward?

A: An ambulance took me to the emergency room that same afternoon. They took X-rays and confirmed the fracture.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I believe the other driver was not paying attention. I was driving cautiously and I'm hoping this gets resolved quickly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
